info.title: VRChat Feedback Search Gateway
info.summary: Public Algolia-shaped search API backed by SearchKit and OpenSearch.
info.description:
### Query modes

- **Strict mode** (default): `params.query` is interpreted as InstantSearch/searchkit strict full-text search: `bool`/`should` of boosted `multi_match` (`best_fields` with `operator: and`) over **`combined_text`**, **`title`**, **`author.name`**, and **`details`**, plus a phrase `multi_match`; short single-character queries bias toward phrase behavior. Trimmed empty string becomes **`match_all`**.
- **Lucene mode**: Pass **`mode=lucene`** as a query parameter on either **GET** or **POST** `/api/search` (alongside whatever body or query-string fields you normally send). Non-empty **`params.query`** is compiled via OpenSearch **`query_string`** instead of strict `multi_match`. On GET, **`mode` alone does not start a search**: at least one of **`q`**, **`query`**, **`hitsPerPage`**, or **`page`** must be present.

### Lucene semantics (`mode=lucene`)

Each **`query_string`** clause uses **`default_operator: AND`**, **`lenient: true`**, **`analyze_wildcard: true`**. Grammar follows OpenSearch; see **[query_string query](https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/query-dsl/full-text/query-string/)**.

**Post-level bare terms** (no leading `field:` after routing): **`query_string`** over **`combined_text^3`**, **`title^2`**, **`details`**, **`author.name`**, **`aiCategories`**.

**Comment routing**: The user's string is split on **` AND `** (spaces required — avoids **`fooANDbar`**) only at parenthesis depth 0 and outside **`'`** / **`"`** quotes. Each chunk has leading **`NOT`** prefixes removed (each flips overall negation for that chunk), redundant outer parentheses stripped until stable (**quote-aware**, balanced `()`), then **`classifyClause`** examines the **`field`** in **`field:value`**. If the field is **`comments`** or **`comments.*`**, the chunk becomes a **`nested`** query on path **`comments`** with an inner **`query_string`** (**no explicit `fields` list** → all mapped `comments` fields). Otherwise it is a post-level **`query_string`**. Positive post clauses are merged into **one** post **`query_string`** joined with **` AND `**. Each positive routed comment clause is its own **`must`** nested **`query_string`**. Negated clauses are **`must_not`** (post **`query_string`** or nested **`comments`** **`query_string`** as appropriate).

**Empty / whitespace-only queries** behave as **`match_all`**.

### Lucene field quick reference

| Field | Kind | Example |
| ----- | ----- | ------- |
| `title` | text | `title:avatar` |
| `details` | text | `details:"network lag"` |
| `combined_text` | text | `combined_text:performance` |
| `author.name` | text | `author.name:Alice` |
| `status` | keyword | `status:open` |
| `board.urlName` | keyword | `board.urlName:bug-reports` |
| `board.name` | text | `board.name:bug` |
| `board.name.keyword` | keyword | `board.name.keyword:"Feature Requests"` |
| `category.name` | text | `category.name:sdk` |
| `category.name.keyword` | keyword | `category.name.keyword:SDK` |
| `author.name.keyword` | keyword | `author.name.keyword:"Jane Doe"` |
| `score` | numeric | `score:[10 TO *]` |
| `maxScore` | numeric | `maxScore:[100 TO *]` |
| `commentCount` | numeric | `commentCount:[1 TO 50]` |
| `mergeCount` | numeric | `mergeCount:[1 TO *]` |
| `trendingScore` | numeric | `trendingScore:[500 TO *]` |
| `voteSettings.highEngagement` | keyword / bool-like | `voteSettings.highEngagement:true` |
| `voteSettings.moderateEngagement` | keyword / bool-like | `voteSettings.moderateEngagement:true` |
| `voteSettings.lowEngagement` | keyword / bool-like | `voteSettings.lowEngagement:true` |
| `created` | date | `created:["2025-01-01" TO "2026-01-01"]` |
| `updatedAt` | date | `updatedAt:["2025-01-01" TO *]` |
| `statusChanged` | date | `statusChanged:["2025-01-01" TO *]` |
| `comments.value` | text | `comments.value:"network lag"` |
| `comments.author.name` | text | `comments.author.name:Alice` |
| `comments.author.name.keyword` | keyword | `comments.author.name.keyword:"Jane Doe"` |
| `comments.pinned` | keyword | `comments.pinned:true` |
| `comments.likeCount` | numeric | `comments.likeCount:[1 TO *]` |
| `comments.created` | date | `comments.created:["2025-01-01" TO *]` |
| `aiCategories` | text | `aiCategories:groups` |
| `aiCategories.keyword` | keyword | `aiCategories.keyword:"groups.calendar"` |
| `aiTaggedAt` | date | `aiTaggedAt:["2025-01-01" TO *]` |

Canonical mappings: **`deploy/opensearch/index_mappings.json`** in this repository.

externalDocs.description: SearchKit gateway reference (request/response shape, Algolia parity).

tags.name: Search
tags.description: Algolia-compatible search endpoints backed by SearchKit and OpenSearch.

post.summary: Run one or more InstantSearch queries.
post.description: Request body must be a JSON array of InstantSearch multi-query items. **`mode`** is read from the URL query string (not the JSON body): use **`mode=lucene`** for Lucene/query_string semantics (see **`info.description`**). Maximum JSON body size is **512 KiB**.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Omit for strict boosted `multi_match` over search attributes (`combined_text`, `title`, `author.name`, `details`). **`lucene`**: compile each item's **`params.query`** using OpenSearch **`query_string`** (see **`info.description`**, Lucene sections).

facetedQuery.summary: Faceted query with filters and sort replica score_desc

400.description: **Malformed**: body is not a JSON array. **Invalid query**: upstream OpenSearch returned HTTP 400 (bad Lucene/filter syntax); body uses **`Invalid search query`** plus optional **`detail`**. Same schema for both cases.

value.message: Expected a JSON array of InstantSearch multiple-queries payloads

413.description: JSON body exceeds the gateway parser limit **512 KiB** (`express.json({ limit: "512kb" })`). Typical Express response is plain **`Payload Too Large`** text; treat as **`413`** regardless of **`Content-Type`**.

500.description: Search execution failed upstream (OpenSearch error, network failure, etc.).

get.summary: Run a single query via query string, or return a discovery document.
get.description:
Two behaviours are multiplexed onto this endpoint:

### 1. Single-query search (parity with POST)

If **any** of **`q`**, **`query`**, **`hitsPerPage`**, or **`page`** is supplied, the gateway constructs exactly **one** multi-query element targeting **`feedback-posts`** and forwards it through the same **`@searchkit/api#handleRequest`** pipeline as POST. **`mode=lucene`** in the URL opts into Lucene/`query_string` for **`params.query`** (same as POST).

| Query parameter | Maps to | Default | Notes |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| **`q`** or **`query`** | **`params.query`** | `""` | **`q`** wins when both appear. |
| **`hitsPerPage`** | **`params.hitsPerPage`** | `50` | Clamped **`[1, 500]`**; invalid ⇒ `50`. |
| **`page`** | **`params.page`** | `0` | Clamped **`[0, 9999]`**; invalid ⇒ `0`. |
| **`mode`** | query parser selection | _(omit ⇒ strict)_ | **`lucene`** only. Does **not** trigger search unless one of **`q`**/**`query`**/**`hitsPerPage`**/**`page`** is present. |

Features that cannot be expressed via query string (multiple queries, facets, **`filters`**, custom **`indexName`**, sort replicas, etc.) require POST.

### 2. Service discovery

With **none** of **`q`**, **`query`**, **`hitsPerPage`**, or **`page`** present (even if **`mode=lucene`** appears alone), the gateway returns JSON describing endpoints. POST has no equivalent mode.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search terms. Maps to **`params.query`**. Takes precedence over **`query`** when both are supplied.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Alias of **`q`**. Ignored when **`q`** is also present.

parameters.name: hitsPerPage
parameters.description: Page size. Defaults to **`50`**. Values outside **`[1, 500]`** or non-numeric input fall back to **`50`**.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Zero-based page index. Defaults to **`0`**. Values outside **`[0, 9999]`** or non-numeric input fall back to **`0`**.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Omit for strict boosted `multi_match`. **`lucene`** for **`query_string`** (**see **`info.description`**)**. Alone does **not** switch out of discovery; needs **`q`**, **`query`**, **`hitsPerPage`**, or **`page`**.

200.description: Either a search-results envelope (when search parameters are supplied) or the discovery document (when none are supplied).

value.description: POST: JSON array of InstantSearch multiple-queries (see /openapi.json). GET: discovery when no search params; otherwise one-query search (q/query, hitsPerPage, page) — subset of POST. Optional query param mode=lucene uses OpenSearch query_string (Lucene) for params.query instead of strict multi_match. Contract: openapi.json.

400.description: OpenSearch rejected the assembled query (**`query_string`**, **`filters`**, etc.). **`detail`** echoes upstream error detail when parseable.

500.description: Search execution failed upstream. Discovery mode never reaches SearchKit and therefore never produces this status.

options.description: Answered by nginx with `204 No Content` and the public CORS headers (`Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`, `Access-Control-Allow-Methods: GET, POST, OPTIONS, HEAD`, `Access-Control-Allow-Headers: Authorization, Content-Type, Accept, X-Requested-With`, `Access-Control-Max-Age: 86400`). The gateway process is not involved.

get.description: Proxied by nginx to the gateway's internal `/health` endpoint. Returns `200 OK` with the plain-text body `ok` when the gateway process is reachable. A `502 Bad Gateway` indicates that nginx cannot reach the gateway upstream.

502.description: nginx cannot reach the gateway upstream.

get.description: Served as a static file by nginx. Always reflects the contract of the gateway running on the same host.

MultiQueryRequest.description: InstantSearch multi-query payload. Each element describes one query against one index. Field semantics follow the Algolia search API; see SearchKit and Algolia docs for **`params`** keys accepted by **`@searchkit/api`**. Query semantics for **`params.query`** also depend on URL **`mode=lucene`** (see **`info.description`**).

indexName.description:
Target InstantSearch/Sort replica name. **`feedback-posts`** is the primary index (**default sort: `created desc`** via Searchkit **`default`**). Explicit sort replicas exposed by gateway config: **`feedback-posts_created_asc`**, **`feedback-posts_score_desc`**, **`feedback-posts_score_asc`**, **`feedback-posts_relevance_desc`** (sort `_score desc`). Names follow Searchkit stripping rules (suffix **`_`** + sort key).
There is **`no`** **`feedback-posts_created_desc`** replica — newest-first sorting is **`feedback-posts`** unsuffixed.

params.description: Algolia-compatible search parameters. Only common fields enumerated; **`additionalProperties`** allowed for other Searchkit-supported keys.

query.description: **Free-text** InstantSearch **`params.query`**. Empty or whitespace-only ⇒ **`match_all`**. Interpretation (strict boosted `multi_match` vs `query_string`) is controlled by **`?mode=lucene`** on the HTTP request; see **`info.description`**.

facets.description: Facet attributes to compute. Post-level (**string**/keyword unless noted): **`board_slug`**, **`board_name`**, **`status`**, **`category_name`**, **`author_name`**, **`aiCategories`**, **`vote_highEngagement`**, **`vote_lowEngagement`**, **`vote_moderateEngagement`**; numeric/date-style post facets (**numeric** facets in SearchKit): **`score`**, **`maxScore`**, **`commentCount`**, **`mergeCount`**, **`trendingScore`**, **`post_created`** (`created`), **`post_updated`** (`updatedAt`), **`post_statusChanged`** (`statusChanged`). Nested (**comment**) facets (post matches if ≥1 nested comment satisfies): **`comment_author_name`**, **`comment_pinned`**, **`comment_likeCount`**, **`comment_created`** (~`comments.created`).

facetFilters.description: Algolia-style facet filter expression (string, array of strings, or array of arrays for OR-of-AND).

SearchResponse.description: Algolia-compatible search-results envelope produced by **`@searchkit/api`**. The **`results`** array contains one entry per query in order.

SearchResult.description: Single-query result. Mirrors Algolia **`SearchResponse`**; only commonly used fields enumerated.

page.description: Zero-based page index of this result.

hitsPerPage.description: Page size used for this result.

facets.description: Facet counts keyed by facet attribute → value.

Hit.description: Indexed feedback-post `_source` as returned via Searchkit **`result_attributes`**, plus Algolia **`objectID`**, **`_highlightResult`**, **`_snippetResult`**. Canonical field types/shapes: **`deploy/opensearch/index_mappings.json`**.

DiscoveryResponse.description: Returned by **`GET /api/search`** when **`q`**, **`query`**, **`hitsPerPage`**, and **`page`** are all absent (**`mode`** alone does not imply search). Mirrors runtime **`getDiscoveryJson()`** string.

detail.description: Upstream parse/validation detail when **`message`** is **`Invalid search query`** (Elasticsearch/OpenSearch **`400`** body extracted by gateway). Omit for simple client errors (**expected JSON array**, etc.).
